idea-plugin.name: Tibero Database Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Tibero Database Tools brings Tibero database development features to IntelliJ IDEA's built-in Database Tools. Explore database objects, develop PL/SQL, complete SQL references, and analyze execution plans in a familiar IDE environment. Free and open source under the Apache License 2.0 license.

  • Object Exploration and Completion: Browse procedures, functions, packages, package members, and sequences. Complete package members with parameter lists, IN/OUT modes, return types, and overloaded signatures.
  • Stored Object Editing: View and edit procedures, functions, package specifications and bodies, and views. CREATE OR REPLACE editing with Submit integration is available in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.
  • PL/SQL Development: Generate editable routine execution blocks with parameters, OUT variables, and return values. Capture DBMS_OUTPUT messages and inspect compilation errors with line and column details.
  • Execution Plan Analysis: Explore estimated plans using native tree, table, and diagram views, including costs, estimated rows, and access/filter predicates. Explain Analyse executes SELECT/WITH queries and displays actual rows, execution time, Starts, and Buffer Gets.
  • Database Links and Remote Completion: Browse private and PUBLIC links, open reconstructed DDL, and navigate to definitions. Complete remote tables and columns by mapping each link to a separately registered and refreshed remote data source and schema. Mappings persist across IDE restarts.
  • Catalogue Query Shortcuts: Prepare SQL queries in a new console to inspect object definitions, routine arguments, dependencies, dependent objects, triggers, synonyms, sequences, compilation errors, and object privileges.
  • Tibero SQL and JDBC Integration: Use Oracle SQL/PLSQL dialect integration, current-schema and PUBLIC synonym resolution, and improved Tibero function argument and JDBC data type metadata.

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1.5–2026.2.x, Database Tools and SQL, Diagrams, and a separately supplied Tibero JDBC driver JAR.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Resolves DB link names in SQL, removing false unresolved-link errors. Fixes Database tree double-click navigation and the current IDE navigation API. Retains persisted link catalogues and remote mappings.
